Dialogs.Dialog: Well, I was wondering what you think of me lately. You've felt a little cold...
I just thought it would be best to ask.
Don't make me worry any more than this...
(Hmm, is she really hurt？ I guess I have been a bit cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again!
Don't worry about it so much!
Do I just have to put up with it again？
It's not about putting up with it... I said I won't do it again.
...Sorry, let me think for a bit.
All right. I'll put up with it.
Put up with it... I won't do it again.
(Did she forgive me？ I feel like she's not really convinced...)
Hey, haven't you been cold to me lately？
I don't think it's just my imagination.
I don't just want an apology. I want you to really think about it.
Try thinking back on how you've been lately？
(She's serious... I guess I have been a bit cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again!
Don't worry about it so much!
Maybe sometimes... you need a real punishment.
What!? I swear I'll reflect on it!
Sometimes words just aren't enough. See you.
*Sigh*... I'll let it go this time.
If you're thinking 'Yay, I'm saved!', you're gonna get it.
(She forgave me, right？ I feel like she's still not totally convinced, though...)
I feel like you've been a bit cold to me lately... What do you think？
What do I think...? Have I really？
I'm the one asking you, you know？ I want a real answer.
Do you have any idea why？
(She seems serious... I guess I have been a bit cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again!
Don't worry about it so much!
...Aren't you the one in the wrong here？
Did you think saying that would make me forgive you？
...You really are a spoiled boy. I guess I need to be strict sometimes, or you'll go bad.
You think that'll get you off the hook again. Aren't you getting a little carried away？
(She forgave me, right？ I feel like she's still not totally convinced, though...)
(Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she still mad at me？)
Ask her to go home together
Sorry. I haven't sorted out my feelings yet.
(She might still be mad, so I'll pass...)
(Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she still mad at me？)
Ask her to go home together
No. You know why, don't you？
(She might still be mad, so I'll pass...)
(Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she still mad at me？)
Ask her to go home together
Huh？ But I haven't forgiven you yet.
(She might still be mad, so I'll pass...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
No... I'm not really in the mood for that yet.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
A date. Are you really in a position to ask that？
I'll answer, for now. What is it？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
Points for trying to make it up to me. But still no.
(A call... Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
We had a date planned, right？ Remember？
Let's call it off, okay？ I can't go feeling like this.
(A call... Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
So, about that date we had planned...
(A call... Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
That date we planned. Are you looking forward to it？
Too bad, it's canceled. See you.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, can we meet up right now？
...I can't. Even if we met, I wouldn't know what to do.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, can we meet up right now？
Well, can you get here in 10 seconds？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, can we meet up right now？
It's good that you always try your best, but...
Does working hard like that make you forget the bad stuff？ ...Just kidding.
If only you thought about us that seriously...
I'm not gonna help you, even if you're in trouble.
Wow. ...I guess you really don't care, huh.
Working hard at that won't make me forgive you.
Good job. Though your skills as a boyfriend are terrible.
Making that face won't make me comfort you.
Oh my, can't you do anything by yourself？
(Ah, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she still mad？)
(I should leave her alone for now.)
(Ah, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she still mad？)
(I should leave her alone for now.)
(Ah, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she still mad？)
...You're still messing around at a time like this.
(I should leave her alone for now.)
Jeez, you're taking it so easy.
You worked so hard for me.
Yeah, I don't want to make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ worry anymore.
I'm sorry for hurting you. I just couldn't let it go.
● is the one at fault. If only ● had it together from the start.
No, it's fine now. I just... I can't be without you...
Yeah, ● too. I really do love ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Yeah. That's all I need to hear right now.
You really tried your best. Even though I said some pretty awful things.
It's ● who's to blame. I'm sorry.
Right, it's your fault... And yet.
Being mean to you while we were fighting was a little fun, but...
That's not enough for me. It's much more fun when we're getting along.
Yeah, you've thought about what you did, right?
Yeah... It's only natural I made ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ mad. I'm a bad boyfriend, sorry.
A bad boyfriend, huh... I wonder if forgiving a boyfriend like that makes me a bad girlfriend...
Yeah. I guess I really am bad. I'm already thinking about something else.
I want to make up for the time I was lonely.
I came to visit. Are you okay?
Sorry for dropping by so suddenly.
No, I'm happy. I really wanted to see you.
But if I knew you were coming, I would have prepared properly.
Don't push yourself when you're sick. ● will help you instead.
It's fine. Just having you here is enough.
I shouldn't stay too long. I'll get going soon.
Yeah, sorry. I couldn't even host you properly.
I told you it's fine. See ya.
●. How are you feeling? I came to visit.
Yeah, mostly. Ah, disappointed? Did you want to take care of me?
No way, it's obviously better that you're well. Though if you needed me to, I'd gladly take care of you.
I see... I should have acted sicker. My mistake.
Ah, sorry for staying long. I'll go home now.
Just kidding. I'd give you my cold. Be careful, okay?
Thanks. Hold on, I'll open the door.
Yeah, it's not too bad. I was just starting to get tired of sleeping.
So I came at a good time？
Yeah, perfect. You'll keep me company, right？
As long as you don't push yourself.
Sorry, we've been talking a while. Are you okay？
Not at all. If anything, I think I feel better.
I see. But I should get going soon, you must be tired.
Yeah, thanks. Make sure to wash your hands and gargle when you get home, okay？
Hey. I'm happy you came to visit, but is it okay to just focus on me？
It's fine, you're the most important thing to me.
Was I trying too hard to act cool？
I'm bored... I want to go outside.
You're so calm. It's like our roles are reversed, and it's a little frustrating.
Haha, then I'll enjoy it while it lasts.
It's nice you're visiting me, but are you studying？ Is your part-time job okay？
You don't need to worry about that. Right now you should focus on yourself.
But I can't help but worry.
I'm doing fine. You don't need to worry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Yeah... but that's kind of lonely too. I should get better soon.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Are you all better now？
Sorry to make you worry, I'm fine now.
Thanks for visiting me, too. But I was still lonely, so...
Yeah. Let's spend time together to make up for when you were sick.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Are you all better now？
Of course. Thanks to you, right？ Thanks for visiting.
I let you see me all weak and helpless... Now it's time for payback.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Are you already feeling better？
Thanks for worrying about me. I'm completely fine now.
I guess it's my turn to worry about you now. I want to take care of you, after all.
...●, do you have to catch a cold for that to happen？
Hehe, just kidding. Don't catch one. Being healthy is the most important thing.
(I'm so bored... I'm tired of just sitting around at home.)
Yep, I came to check on you. If I'm not bothering you, that is.
Thank you for going out of your way.
I just couldn't stop worrying. Sorry about that.
No, it's fine. I was getting bored, so your timing is perfect.
Ah, I ended up talking too long. Even if you're recovering, it's bad for you to overdo it.
I don't think that's true, but...
Even if you don't realize it, your body is definitely tired. I'll head home now, so get some rest.
Okay. I got it. Thank you.
(I need to get better soon, for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s sake too.)
(I'm so bored... I'm tired of just sitting around at home.)
I came to check on you. How are you feeling？
You came to see me. Thank you.
Yeah. I totally thought you'd be a lot weaker, though.
Don't be so on guard. I was planning to nurse you back to health.
We ended up talking a lot. I'll head home before you feel worse.
If you're really thankful, make sure to rest up and get better.
(I need to get better soon, for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s sake too.)
(I'm so bored... I'm tired of just sitting around at home.)
Of course, I came to see you. Hehe, were you waiting for me？
Yeah, you look better than I expected. Your room's tidy too, which is a shame.
I was hoping to dote on you a whole bunch.
Ah, I should get going. There's no point to my visit if I make you feel worse.
No way. Listen to your big sister and get some proper rest, okay？
Yep, good boy. See you later.
(I need to get better fast, for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s sake.)
How are you feeling? Sleepy? Should I leave you alone?
Okay, is there anything you want me to do?
You don't have to do anything. Just stay.
Hey, are you feeling any better yet?
A lot better, but I'm not completely cured yet.
Then let's try a few things. Like sketchy folk remedies.
...Because I get lonely when you're sick.
You're surprisingly low- maintenance, aren't you?
And here I thought I'd get to take care of you more.
Probably not what you're imagining right now.
Sorry to keep you waiting. I'm all better now.
Thank goodness... Are you really okay?
Yeah, thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ coming to visit me.
Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Yep, fully recovered. Thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I see... I kind of wanted to see you weak a bit longer.
Just a bit. But I like you better when you're healthy.
Sorry for worrying you. I'm all better now.
Of course. Now I just want to hurry and go out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Good. Looks like it worked perfectly, didn't it?
